## Subsequent wording correction, 6 October 2026

Ren's exact follow-up message:

> "付费记录"? 这个词选的很诡异，太市场了，不够基本

AI interpretation and implementation: the assistant had elevated a local model's resource-consuming write into the foundational phrase “付费记录”. Describe the basic relation as activity changing subsequent conditions, with some changes persisting and participating in later activity. Explain when this develops into retention, memory or a record. Describe concrete resource consumption at the level where the model specifies it; neither monetary payment nor a universally positive resource cost belongs in the definition of recording. The original message and earlier source context above are preserved.

## Keep foundational language at the right level

[Ren's terminology correction](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-06-nondual-core-tree-continuation.md#subsequent-wording-correction-6-october-2026) rejects “付费记录” as too market-like and insufficiently basic. Begin with activity changing subsequent conditions; some changes persist and participate in later activity. This does not yet posit a separate recorder, a representation or a subject remembering an object. Explain the specific relations that constitute retention, memory or a record where those descriptions apply.

Use “记录的形成与更新” / “record formation and updating” when describing the formed learner. Its selected write rule consumes one fuel unit; that is a local mechanism detail, not the meaning of recording. Retention may involve maintenance, decay or transformation, whose conditions must be explained in the relevant process. Do not promote payment, a fixed resource budget or a universally positive cost into a generative primitive. Existing names such as `paid`, `rent` and `lease` remain traceable local-model vocabulary; their presence in source code does not establish market organization at the foundation.

## Make analytical separations accountable

replacements.before: A paid write changes the record, available fuel, phase and future command together.
replacements.after: The record update changes the retained score, available fuel, phase and future command together; the selected local rule consumes one fuel unit.

replacements.before: Begin with activity changing subsequent conditions; some changes persist and participate in later activity.
replacements.after: Begin with activity forming, maintaining or changing the conditions of subsequent activity; some effects continue and participate in later activity.
